newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Marcopper sued over $2 mln bank credit.
newsitem.headline: Marcopper sued over $2 mln bank credit.

text.p: Marcopper Mining Corp said on Wednesday it was ordered by a Manila court to pay 30 million pesos to Solid Banking Corp following a dispute over a $2 million credit facility.
In a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange, Marcopper vice president T.C. Gabor said the company had filed a reconsideration appeal with the Court of Appeals.
The court said the 30 million peso fine will be on top of a surety bond of 58.2 million pesos filed earlier with the court.
The case involves a $2.0 million credit facility opened by Marcopper with Solidbank, a loan which was meant to be repaid from the export proceeds of its copper concentrates.
Marcopper said the loan was not yet due for payment.
Marcopper closed down its mine in the central Philippines in March 1996 after its tailings leaked into and polluted the nearby river.
